tags.name: Iam sync
tags.description: sdvico IAM Sync API for external systems (IUU, MKN, CBVMS) to synchronize users, their organizations and organization roles. Authenticated with its own API resource, not the Management API.

tags.name: Iam sync preview
tags.description: Admin Console preview of the data that the IAM Sync API returns.

IamSyncOAuth2.description: Machine-to-machine access token for the IAM Sync API. Request it with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `resource=https://<tenant-id>.logto.app/iam-sync` and `scope=iam-sync:read`. A token issued for the Management API is rejected with 401.

scopes.iam-sync:read: Read users, their organizations and organization roles.

id.description: Stable IAM user ID. External systems should store it as the permanent link key.

organizations.description: Organizations the user belongs to, limited to those the calling application may see. Optional fields are omitted when the organization does not define them.

level.description: Legacy IAM level: `trung_uong`, `vung`, `tinh` or `co_so`. Only `trung_uong` widens what an application may see.

type.description: Unit type: `ROOT`, `CUC`, `KN_VUNG`, `TINH`, `CHI_CUC`, `BDBP_TINH`, `BQL_CANG`, `DON_BP` or `CANG`. External systems map it to their own permissions.

parentOrgId.description: ID of the parent organization in the tree.

sourceCode.description: Code of the border post or port in the source catalog (`DON_BP` and `CANG` only).

roleTitles.description: Job title of each role code at this unit type, e.g. `{ "TRUONG": "Đồn trưởng" }`.

roles.description: Organization roles. A user holding roles in several organizations has one entry per organization.

code.description: Stable role code: `TRUONG`, `PHO`, `CHUYEN_VIEN`, or a code derived from the role ID.

organizationId.description: Organization where the user holds this role.

external_ids.description: User IDs in legacy systems, keyed by system name (e.g. `mkn`). Omitted when the user has none.

get.description: Return every user the calling machine-to-machine application may see, without pagination (up to 1000 users per organization). An application that is a member of an organization with `level = trung_uong` sees users of all organizations; otherwise it sees users of its organizations and their descendants via `parentOrgId`. Fields are only ever added, never renamed or removed.

200.description: Users visible to the calling application.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or issued for another resource.

403.description: The token does not belong to a machine-to-machine application, lacks the `iam-sync:read` scope, or the application is not a member of any organization.

get.description: Return every user of every organization in the same shape as the IAM Sync API. Used by the Admin Console to preview what external systems receive.

200.description: All users in the IAM Sync API shape.
